project_type: Fastify 5 REST API (Node.js, ESM, TypeScript), clean/hexagonal layering with per-use-case folders and a hand-rolled DI container (resolve* functions)
build_system: tsup (esbuild) for build; tsx for dev/run. No codegen or snapshot files relevant to this task.
test_framework: Vitest. Unit specs are *.spec.ts (vitest.config.ts). E2E specs are *.e2e-spec.ts under src/infrastructure/fastify/tests (vitest-e2e.config.ts), run via scripts/run-e2e.ts which provisions MongoDB + MailDev.
build_command: npm run build (tsup) — not required for verification; use typecheck instead.
test_command: npm run test  (NODE_ENV=testing vitest run -c vitest.config.ts)
verification_instructions: Primary gates (no external services needed): 1) npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit) -> no errors. 2) npm run test -> all unit specs pass; or targeted: npm run test -- src/core/accounts/useCases/auth/requestPasswordReset src/core/accounts/useCases/auth/confirmPassword. 3) npm run lint (eslint .) -> no errors, catches unused imports left in profile.routes.ts. E2E (npm run test:e2e -- <files>) needs MongoDB + SMTP and is optional/secondary. Finally run the grep assertions in FEAT-001.verification.
environment_constraints: ESLint flags unused imports as errors, so removing the reset-password route from profile.routes.ts REQUIRES deleting the resetPasswordSchema/resetPasswordController imports too. E2E tests require MongoDB (managed by default) and a MailDev SMTP server; if unavailable, rely on typecheck + unit + lint. Repo is on branch 'develop' with pre-existing unrelated uncommitted changes (.agents artifacts, README.md, TODO.md, .env.example) — stage only files this task touches.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING.md in repo. README documents commands. Repo file-naming convention: service file PascalCase.service.ts; controller/container/schema/dtos/spec camelCase.<role>.ts; folder camelCase. Imports use the @/ path alias (maps to src/). Commit locally only; never push.
key_patterns: Each use case folder contains: <name>.schema.ts (zod), <name>.dtos.ts (types incl. <Name>ReqBody = z.infer<typeof schema>), <Name>.service.ts (class <Name>Service with execute(), BadRequestError path tags like '<Name>.service.N'), <name>.controller.ts (const <name>Controller + resolve<Name>Service()), <name>.container.ts (builds the service singleton, exports resolve<Name>Service), <name>.spec.ts (Vitest unit test with in-memory repos). Routes are registered in src/infrastructure/fastify/routes/*.routes.ts using server.withTypeProvider<ZodTypeProvider>().post(path, { schema: { tags, summary, description, body } }, controller).
directory_structure: src/core/accounts/useCases/{auth,profile,users}/<useCase>/ hold application-layer use cases. src/infrastructure/fastify/routes/ holds route plugins. src/infrastructure/fastify/tests/{auth,profile,...}/ hold e2e specs. src/shared/providers/{date,template,mailer,cryptography,queue} hold shared providers. src/core/accounts/entities/ holds entities incl. userToken.entity.ts (TokenTypeEnum). src/shared/constants/ holds frontend.constants.ts.

do_not_rename_preserved.token_type_enum: TokenTypeEnum['forgot-password'] in src/core/accounts/entities/userToken.entity.ts — persisted value; all services keep using it (incl. unrelated deleteProfile.spec.ts and users/delete/deleteUser.spec.ts).
do_not_rename_preserved.queue_job_name: EMAIL_JOB_NAMES.forgotPassword: 'forgot-password' in src/shared/providers/queue/email/emailQueue.constants.ts and its use in emailQueue.types.ts — BullMQ job name.
do_not_rename_preserved.email_template: src/shared/providers/template/implementations/views/forgotPassword.template.ts (+ its .spec.ts), forgotPasswordTemplate, ForgotPasswordProps (template.dtos.ts), ITemplateProvider.forgotPassword(...) and its Mjml.provider.ts impl — keep all named forgotPassword/ForgotPassword. RequestPasswordResetService still calls this.templateProvider.forgotPassword(...).
do_not_rename_preserved.frontend_path: FRONTEND_PAGE_PATHS.resetPassword: '/reset-password' in src/shared/constants/frontend.constants.ts — a FRONTEND url, not a backend route; the request-reset service keeps building the link with it.
do_not_rename_preserved.schema_field: The 'confirmPassword' body field (and the password === confirmPassword refinement) inside the reset/confirm schema is a request-contract field name, NOT a use-case identifier. Keep it literally named confirmPassword even though the use case is now ConfirmPassword.

notes: dateProvider.isExpiredDate(...) already exists and is used by both services; no private isExpired methods remain and no DateProvider change is needed. No barrel/index files re-export these use cases; a full-repo grep confirmed references live only in the files listed above plus the two route files.
